_comment: Tind AI box providers, shown by name with their icon (icon: an icon-theme name; Tind's own, tind-ai-*, are in the hicolor theme, shipped by tind-ai-ui). Models as 'name (use)', use one of quick, everyday, coding. 'default' is preselected for a new chat. 'service' says which system user talks to the model: 'remote' (tind-ai-remote, one host only) or 'local' (tind-ai-local, no network; for a model on this computer). 'unavailable' grays the entry with that text. Model ids can be changed per user in the window; these are the suggestions. Long chats (28 Nov), all optional per model: 'context' (tokens the model takes; default 128000), 'summarise_after' (characters of turns after the first exchange before the window asks for a 'chat so far' summary; default 40000), 'reasoning' ({'levels': what the model takes, 'normal' and 'long': what Auto sends for a normal and a long chat, null for nothing}). A model without 'reasoning' gets no reasoning_effort.
